7.1 Indemnify: each side covers other's legal costs/losses if claim stems from (a) broken contract promise, (b) gross negligence/willful misconduct (very careless or intentional harm), (c) deliverables infringe someone's IP -- unless caused by other side's own changes/misuse.
7.2 Process: notify fast (late notice ok unless it hurts the case); paying side controls defense/settlement, can't admit fault or bind you without your consent; both sides cooperate.
7.3 Liability cap: no indirect/lost-profit/punitive damages, except for indemnity duties, confidentiality breach, gross negligence, or IP infringement. Total liability capped at GREATER of fees paid last 12 months, or $100,000.
Plain terms: indemnify = cover other party's losses; gross negligence = extreme carelessness; consequential damages = indirect losses like lost profits; liability cap = max amount you can owe.
